manifest.name: look-here
manifest.description: Selection-first explanations, follow-ups, memories and annotations for DeepSeek Harness web sessions.
manifest.author: ZanderKong

bundle.text:
# look-here 的配置层：插入插件行（跟随 bundle 安装到任意 profile）
- insert:
    - id: look-here-dsh
      name: look-here

readme.text:
English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Look Here is a selection-first plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI. Select text in a DSH conversation to explain it, ask a follow-up, save the answer, or attach an annotation without interrupting the main session.

- **Explain from a selection:** select conversation text and use the nearby dot for a quick explanation or custom question.
- **Keep side work separate:** explanations and follow-ups use an independent `ctx.llm` call and do not add messages to the main DSH session.
- **Choose the answer model:** follow the active session or select a provider and model in the plugin settings.
- **Save reading memory:** keep full answers or excerpts and surface previous explanations when the same term appears again.
- **Build an annotation batch:** collect multiple anchored notes, edit them in the drawer, then drag them into the DSH composer.
- **Stay in control:** dropping annotations only updates the draft. Look Here never sends the main-session message automatically.
- **Match your environment:** Chinese and English UI, theme colors, configurable selection gestures, and reduced-motion support.

- Node.js 22.19+ on the 22.x release line, or Node.js 24+
- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7`
- A DSH `web` profile

The supported Harness version and verified plugin contracts are recorded in [COMPATIBILITY.md](docs/dsh-adaptation/COMPATIBILITY.md).

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:ZanderKong/look-here
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web
```

Restart the Web service after installation. The dumped config should include a `# == look-here` layer, and the UI is available at `http://127.0.0.1:3080` by default.

For a reproducible installation, append `#<commit-or-tag>` to the GitHub spec.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ZanderKong/look-here.git
cd look-here
npm install
npm run check

1. Open a DSH conversation and select text in an assistant response.
2. Short-press the selection dot to explain, or long-press it to ask or annotate. The priority can be changed in settings.
3. Save useful explanations, add follow-ups, or collect several annotations.
4. Drag the annotation basket into the composer, review the draft, and send it yourself.

Run these commands in the browser DevTools console:

```js
await __LOOK_HERE_DSH_DIAGNOSTICS__.health()
await __LOOK_HERE_DSH_DIAGNOSTICS__.selfTest()
await __LOOK_HERE_DSH_DIAGNOSTICS__.quickExplainJobs()
await __LOOK_HERE_DSH_DIAGNOSTICS__.storage()

```sh
npm install
npm run build:dsh
npm test
```

`npm run check` rebuilds the distributable DSH client and host files before running the complete test suite.

```text
dsh/                  DSH host, client adapters, Cordis patch, and build script
src/                  Shared product core adapted from the Chrome extension
dist/dsh/             Committed installable host and client artifacts
tests/dsh/            DSH adapter and behavior tests

See [Architecture](docs/dsh-adaptation/ARCHITECTURE.md), [Installation and acceptance](docs/dsh-adaptation/INSTALL.md), and the [Parity checklist](docs/dsh-adaptation/PARITY_CHECKLIST.md) for implementation details.

- Selected text, surrounding conversation context, questions, and follow-ups are sent through the model provider configured in DeepSeek Harness.
- Plugin settings, saved explanations, and annotations are stored locally in the browser profile used by the DSH Web UI.
- The plugin does not read or store a model API key and does not automatically submit composer drafts.

Avoid selecting sensitive information unless the configured model provider is allowed to process it.

Look Here adapts the interaction model and product core of the [original Chrome extension](https://github.com/ZanderKong/whats-this-again) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Host-specific behavior lives behind DSH adapters; it is not a separate feature rewrite.
This repository uses the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic recommended by the DeepSeek Harness project, so it can be discovered from the Harness plugin community on GitHub.
[MIT](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | 简体中文

喏这里是一个用于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI 的划词交互插件。在 DSH 会话里选中文字后，可以直接解释、继续提问、保存回答或添加批注，同时不打断主会话。

- **划词解释**：选中会话文字后显示圆点；短按快速解释，长按自定义提问或批注，优先动作可在设置中切换。
- **旁路处理**：解释和追问使用独立的 `ctx.llm` 调用，不向 DSH 主会话追加消息。
- **回答模型可选**：可以跟随当前会话，也可以在插件设置中指定 Provider 和模型。
- **保存阅读记忆**：保存完整回答或节选，再次遇到相同词语时显示历史提示。
- **批注工作流**：暂存多个锚定批注，在抽屉中编辑，然后拖入 DSH 输入框。
- **不会自动发送**：拖入批注只会修改草稿，最终内容始终由用户检查并手动发送。
- **适配使用环境**：支持中英文界面、主题色、划词手势设置和减少动态效果。

- Node.js 22.19+（22.x 版本线），或 Node.js 24+
- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7`
- 可用的 DSH `web` profile

已经验证的 Harness 版本与插件接口见 [COMPATIBILITY.md](docs/dsh-adaptation/COMPATIBILITY.md)。

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:ZanderKong/look-here
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web
```

安装后需要重启 Web 服务。配置输出中应出现 `# == look-here` 层；默认访问地址为 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`。

如果需要可复现安装，可以在 GitHub spec 后追加 `#<commit-or-tag>`。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ZanderKong/look-here.git
cd look-here
npm install
npm run check

1. 打开 DSH 会话，选中一段 Assistant 输出。
2. 短按圆点直接解释，或长按后提问、添加批注；具体优先动作可以在设置中调整。
3. 保存有用的解释、继续追问，或者收集多个批注。
4. 把批注篮拖进输入框，检查草稿后再手动发送。

在浏览器 DevTools console 中运行：

```js
await __LOOK_HERE_DSH_DIAGNOSTICS__.health()
await __LOOK_HERE_DSH_DIAGNOSTICS__.selfTest()
await __LOOK_HERE_DSH_DIAGNOSTICS__.quickExplainJobs()
await __LOOK_HERE_DSH_DIAGNOSTICS__.storage()

```sh
npm install
npm run build:dsh
npm test
```

`npm run check` 会先重新生成可安装的 DSH client/host 文件，再运行完整测试。

```text
dsh/                  DSH host、client adapter、Cordis patch 与构建脚本
src/                  从 Chrome 插件适配而来的共享产品核心
dist/dsh/             已提交的可安装 host/client 构建产物
tests/dsh/            DSH 适配与行为测试

更多实现细节见[架构说明](docs/dsh-adaptation/ARCHITECTURE.md)、[安装与验收指南](docs/dsh-adaptation/INSTALL.md)和[功能对齐清单](docs/dsh-adaptation/PARITY_CHECKLIST.md)。

- 选中的文字、会话上下文、问题和追问会通过 DeepSeek Harness 当前配置的模型 Provider 处理。
- 插件设置、保存的解释与批注存储在 DSH Web UI 所用浏览器 profile 的本地存储中。
- 插件不读取或保存模型 API Key，也不会自动提交输入框草稿。

除非当前模型 Provider 被允许处理相关内容，否则不要选择敏感信息。
喏这里把[原 Chrome 插件](https://github.com/ZanderKong/whats-this-again)的交互模型与产品核心适配到 DeepSeek Harness Web UI。DSH 特有能力通过 adapter 接入，不是另做一套功能。
本仓库使用 DeepSeek Harness 官方项目推荐的 [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic，因此可以在 GitHub 的 Harness 插件社区中被搜索和发现。
